Class WaterPhaseBoundaryResult

java.lang.Object
neqsim.thermodynamicoperations.WaterPhaseBoundaryResult
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
public final class WaterPhaseBoundaryResult extends Object implements Serializable
Immutable, separately calculated liquid-water, ice and hydrate boundaries for one CPA fluid inventory.

  • Constructor Details

    • WaterPhaseBoundaryResult

      WaterPhaseBoundaryResult(double pressureBara, String model, Map<String,Double> moleFractions, WaterPhaseBoundaryResult.BoundaryResult liquidWater, WaterPhaseBoundaryResult.BoundaryResult ice, WaterPhaseBoundaryResult.BoundaryResult hydrate)
      Creates a complete comparison without retaining mutable fluid objects.
      Parameters:
      pressureBara - absolute calculation pressure in bar
      model - CPA model identity
      moleFractions - overall wet-fluid mole fractions, including inhibitors and oil fractions
      liquidWater - liquid-water result
      ice - ice result
      hydrate - hydrate result
